Title: Some users may be unable to search using the search box in SharePoint Online

Title: Some users may be unable to search using the search box in SharePoint Online

User impact: Users may have been unable to search using the search box in SharePoint Online.

Final status: We've identified that a recent feature update caused a compatibility issue that prevented users from searching in SharePoint Online. We reverted the recent feature update and confirm that impact is remediated.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to search in SharePoint Online may have been impacted.

Start time: Monday, October 5, 2026, at 7:23 AM UTC

End time: Monday, October 5, 2026, at 4:20 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent feature update caused a compatibility issue that prevented users from searching in SharePoint Online. 

Next steps: - We're reviewing and improving our feature update validation procedure to prevent similar search issues from occurring in the future.

This is the final update for this event.
